import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
    p = params
    s = np.sin(p[5]*t); c = np.cos(p[5]*t)
    h = p[2] + p[3]*t + p[4]*t*t + p[6]*s + p[7]*c + p[8]*np.exp(-t) + p[9]*np.log(t) + p[1]*0
    return p[0]*t + p[1]*P*np.log(P) + h/P
